quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap the room where the meeting will now take place.
quests.hint: The original room, the new room, and the reason are all in one sentence. Follow the email.
quests.explanation: Room eight was the speaker's first belief. The email moved the group to a larger room. So the answer is Room 12.
quests.textToSpeak: I thought we were meeting in Room eight, but the coordinator emailed this morning to move us to Room twelve because another class needed the larger space.

quests.instruction: Listen for the earliest day the samples are expected.
quests.hint: The original day is not the real one. Listen for what ‘earliest’ refers to.
quests.explanation: Correct: Wednesday. Monday was the due date, but the delay at customs pushes it to midweek.
quests.textToSpeak: Did Tariq get the samples? Not yet. The courier says they were due Monday, but customs has held them, so the earliest we'll see them is Wednesday.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap who will cover reception on Friday.
quests.hint: The first choice changed. Who took over?
quests.explanation: Sana is correct. The speaker was going to cover, but Sana offered instead.
quests.textToSpeak: Who's covering reception on Friday? I was going to, but Sana offered because she owes me a favor. So I'm free to go to the workshop.

quests.instruction: Listen for why the call was missed.
quests.hint: The answer comes after ‘so’ in the reply. Think about where the speaker was.
quests.explanation: The answer is phone on silent. The lecture is why the speaker had the phone silenced.
quests.textToSpeak: Why didn't you answer? I was in the lecture, so my phone was on silent.

quests.instruction: Spot the new estimated arrival time.
quests.hint: ‘Estimated’ signals the latest information. Ignore the original schedule.
quests.explanation: Correct: 9:15. Six was the original arrival, before the reroute.
quests.textToSpeak: The flight was supposed to land at six, but it was rerouted through Denver, so now the estimated arrival is nine fifteen.

quests.instruction: Listen for who will present the idea.
quests.hint: The idea belongs to one person, but the presentation belongs to another.
quests.explanation: Ben is correct. Alice came up with the idea, but Ben is stronger with numbers.
quests.textToSpeak: It's Alice's idea, but Ben is the one who's going to present it, since he's better with numbers.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap why the speaker can't do Thursday.
quests.hint: Three days are mentioned with three different situations. Match the reason to Thursday.
quests.explanation: Correct: an audit. Friday is a day off, which is a different situation.
quests.textToSpeak: Are you free for lunch? I can do Wednesday but not Thursday. Thursday I've got the audit, and Friday I'm off.

quests.instruction: Listen for what is available again tomorrow but not today.
quests.hint: Some things stay closed, some stay open, and one changes. Look for the one that changes.
quests.explanation: The answer is the sauna. It is closed today and reopens tomorrow. The pool stays closed both days.
quests.textToSpeak: The gym said the pool is closed for cleaning today and tomorrow, but the sauna reopens tomorrow after a repair, and the classes are running as normal.

quests.instruction: Clear the glass and tap the time they settled on.
quests.hint: Three suggestions are made. Listen for the last sentence.
quests.explanation: 10:30 is correct. The final sentence says the group settled on it.
quests.textToSpeak: We set the meeting for ten, then Pia asked if we could make it ten thirty, and Omar said eleven at the latest. We settled on ten thirty.

quests.instruction: Listen for what happens right after registering.
quests.hint: ‘After that’ and ‘then’ mark the order. Find what follows the first step.
quests.explanation: A health check is correct. Waiting in the lounge is the final step.
quests.textToSpeak: First, register at the front desk. After that, go to room three for your health check, and then wait in the lounge until they call your name.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap who the speaker is sending it to.
quests.hint: The first choice isn't available. Listen for the replacement.
quests.explanation: Dr. Hale is away on leave. So the answer is Dr. Ivanov.
quests.textToSpeak: I'd have asked Dr. Hale, but she's on leave until March, so I'm sending it to Dr. Ivanov.

quests.instruction: Catch how much the new place costs per month.
quests.hint: The old rent and new rent are both mentioned. Match the amount to the new place.
quests.explanation: The answer is $1,100. Nine hundred was the old rent.
quests.textToSpeak: Our old landlord charged nine hundred a month, but our new place is eleven hundred, though it includes utilities.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap why the speaker is late.
quests.hint: The obvious excuse is denied. Listen for the real one.
quests.explanation: The answer is the car wouldn't start. Traffic is what the speaker says was not the problem.
quests.textToSpeak: Sorry I'm late. The traffic wasn't the problem. My car wouldn't start, so I had to take the bus.

quests.instruction: Listen for who handles the catering.
quests.hint: Each task is assigned to one person. Link the task to the name.
quests.explanation: Lena books the venue, and the speaker does invitations. So the answer is Kofi.
quests.textToSpeak: So the plan is: Lena books the venue, Kofi handles the catering, and I'll take care of the invitations.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap when the doctor wants to check again.
quests.hint: The follow-up comes at the end. Pay attention to the time expression.
quests.explanation: The answer is in three months. It is when the doctor wants a repeat test.
quests.textToSpeak: I got the results back. They're not bad, but my cholesterol is a bit high, so the doctor wants to check again in three months.

quests.instruction: Clear the glass and tap what to do on this model.
quests.hint: One method is for a different model. Listen for the one that applies to this one.
quests.explanation: Pressing the green button is for the old model. So the answer is hold the back switch.
quests.textToSpeak: The instructions say to press the green button, but that's for the old model. On this one, you hold the small switch at the back for five seconds.

quests.instruction: Listen for how the final price compares.
quests.hint: A saving is mentioned and then cancelled out. Follow the logic to the end.
quests.explanation: The answer is about the same. The online discount is balanced by the service fee.
quests.textToSpeak: The tickets are cheaper if you book online, but there's a service fee, so in the end it's about the same as buying at the door.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap which bus you should take.
quests.hint: One bus is recommended over another. Listen for the reason too.
quests.explanation: Correct: 7:45. The seven thirty is slower because it stops in every village.
quests.textToSpeak: You'll want the seven forty-five bus, not the seven thirty. The seven thirty stops at every village and takes forever.

quests.instruction: Catch the day Mei believed the deadline was.
quests.hint: The real deadline and the misunderstood deadline are both said.
quests.explanation: Thursday is correct. Friday is the real deadline. Mei misheard it.
quests.textToSpeak: I told Mei the deadline was Friday, and she thought I said Thursday, so she rushed to finish a day early.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap who will pay for the taxi.
quests.hint: One person made the suggestion, and another one made the offer. You need the offer.
quests.explanation: The answer is Paolo. Ines only suggested sharing a taxi.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody wanted to drive, so Ines suggested we split a taxi, and Paolo said he'd pay since it's his birthday.

quests.instruction: Listen for when the movie should end.
quests.hint: Add the length of the movie to the start time.
quests.explanation: 9:30 is correct. Seven plus two and a half hours is nine thirty.
quests.textToSpeak: She said the movie was two and a half hours, so if it starts at seven, we'll be out around nine thirty.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap the condition for holding the ceremony in the garden.
quests.hint: ‘As long as’ introduces a condition. Listen for what it needs.
quests.explanation: Correct: good weather. ‘Holds’ here means the weather stays good.
quests.textToSpeak: There's been a slight change. Instead of the main hall, the awards ceremony will be in the garden, as long as the weather holds.

quests.instruction: Notice which book will become a film.
quests.hint: The books are described in order. Watch for ‘now in production’.
quests.explanation: The third novel is correct. It is the one being made into a film.
quests.textToSpeak: His first novel sold well, but the second one didn't. Critics liked it, though, and the third is now in production as a film.

quests.instruction: Tap how the shop will let the speaker know.
quests.hint: The date and the method of contact are different details.
quests.explanation: By text message is correct. The shop will text when the part arrives.
quests.textToSpeak: I rang the shop. They said the part is out of stock but should arrive on the twelfth, and they'll text me when it does.

quests.instruction: Listen for what the speaker was disappointed about.
quests.hint: Something was better than expected and something was worse. Listen for ‘though’.
quests.explanation: The location is correct. The rooms were lovely, so they were not the problem.
quests.textToSpeak: I'll be honest, I expected the hotel to be closer to the center. It's actually a twenty-minute bus ride, though the rooms were lovely.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap the seat the speaker wants.
quests.hint: Two seats are mentioned. One is current, and one is the request.
quests.explanation: The answer is 22A. Fourteen C is where the speaker currently sits.
quests.textToSpeak: Could you swap my seat? I'm in fourteen C, and I'd like to sit with my daughter in twenty-two A.

quests.instruction: Listen for the color they finally chose.
quests.hint: The first plan is rejected. Listen for the word ‘instead’.
quests.explanation: Yellow was the first idea. So the answer is soft gray.
quests.textToSpeak: We were going to paint the kitchen yellow, but my husband felt it was too bright, so we chose a soft gray instead.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap how much the rent was.
quests.hint: Two amounts appear. One is the balance, and one is the payment.
quests.explanation: $600 is correct. Five hundred is the balance in the app.
quests.textToSpeak: The bank's app says my balance is five hundred, but that doesn't include the rent I paid this morning, which was six hundred.

quests.instruction: Listen for where the seminar actually is.
quests.hint: The speaker compares what they were told with what they see.
quests.explanation: In the basement is correct. The sign shows the real location.
quests.textToSpeak: You told me the seminar was on the fourth floor, but the sign says it's in the basement.

quests.instruction: Clear the glass and tap when she will be back at her desk.
quests.hint: Her week is described in order. Choose the last item.
quests.explanation: The answer is Thursday. Monday through Wednesday she is away.
quests.textToSpeak: She'll be at the conference on Monday and Tuesday. On Wednesday she's meeting a client in Leeds, and she'll be back at her desk on Thursday.
